The '''CT-4 series medical droid''' was a class of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] produced by [[Polis Massa Pria Assemblage]] and sold for 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. They were similar to the [[Chroon-Tan B-Machine/Legends|EW-3 midwife droid]], but specialized in producing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. As the droids had a non-[[Human/Legends|human]] shape, they made some patients less easy than [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] did. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used multiple CT-4 series droids.<ref name="Strongholds" />
